item.title: Projects
item.description:
• MOS Predictor for AudioMOS Challenge 2025 [C2] | May 2025 - Jun. 2025
    • Designed MOS prediction systems for effective ranking and comparison of text-to-speech (TTS), text-to-audio (TTA), and text-to-music (TTM) systems.
    • GitHub Repository
  • Keyword Spotter | Mar. 2025 - May 2025
    • Collaborated with Realtek Semiconductor Corp. on an industrial project.
    • Improved two keyword spotting models, BC-ResNet and PhonMatchNet, achieving a 43.23% reduction in false alarms under challenging noise conditions.
  • Voice Activity Detector - SincQDR-VAD [C3] | Nov. 2024 - Feb. 2025
    • Collaborated with Realtek Semiconductor Corp. on an industrial project.
    • Engineered a speech detection pipeline, achieving a significant reduction in false negatives under unseen noise conditions.
    • Hugging Face Demo

Journal Papers

Conference Papers

Cheng-Yeh Yang, Chien-Chun Wang, Li-Wei Chen, Hung-Shin Lee, Hsin-Min Wang, Berlin Chen, “TG-ASR: Translation-guided learning with parallel gated cross attention for low-resource automatic speech recognition,” the 15th edition of the Language Resources and Evaluation Conference (LREC 2026), Palma de Mallorca, Spain, 11-16 May, 2026.
  2. Chien-Chun Wang, Kuan-Tang Huang, Cheng-Yeh Yang, Hung-Shin Lee, Hsin-Min Wang, Berlin Chen, “QAMRO: Quality-aware adaptive margin ranking optimization for human-aligned assessment of audio generation systems,” IEEE workshop on Automatic Speech Recognition and Understanding (ASRU 2025), Honolulu, Hawaii, USA, December 6-10, 2025. (Challenge Track)
  3. Chien-Chun Wang, En-Lun Yu, Jeih-Weih Hung, Shih-Chieh Huang, Berlin Chen, “SincQDR-VAD: A noise-robust voice activity detection framework leveraging learnable filters and ranking-aware optimization,” IEEE workshop on Automatic Speech Recognition and Understanding (ASRU 2025), Honolulu, Hawaii, USA, December 6-10, 2025.
  4. Hung-Yang Sung, Chien-Chun Wang, Kuan-Tang Huang, Tien-Hong Lo, Yu-Sheng Tsao, Yung-Chang Hsu, Berlin Chen, “CLIFT-ASR: A cross-lingual fine-tuning framework for low-resource Taiwanese Hokkien speech recognition,” the 37th International Conference on Computational Linguistics and Speech Processing (ROCLING 2025), Taipei, Taiwan, November 20-22, 2025. (Best Paper Award)
  5. Cheng-Yeh Yang, Kuan-Tang Huang, Chien-Chun Wang, Hung-Shin Lee, Hsin-Min Wang, Berlin Chen, “DRASP: A dual-resolution attentive statistics pooling framework for automatic MOS prediction,” Asia-Pacific Signal and Information Processing Association Annual Summit and Conference (APSIPA ASC 2025), October 22–24, 2025, Singapore.

  8. Chien-Chun Wang, Li-Wei Chen, Hung-Shin Lee, Berlin Chen, Hsin-Min Wang, “Effective noise-aware data simulation for domain-adaptive speech enhancement leveraging dynamic stochastic perturbation,” IEEE Spoken Language Technology Workshop (SLT 2024), Macao, China, December 2–5, 2024.
  9. Hsiao-Shen Wang, Ciao-Si Chang, Chien-Chun Wang, Zhu-Ting Liu, Ting-Yi Hsieh, Pei-Wei Lin, “關鍵學習概念導向人體消化系統多媒體教材設計初探,” the 26th Global Chinese Conference on Computers in Education (GCCCE 2022), Hsinchu, Taiwan; Shanghai and Hong Kong, China (Online), May 28–June 1, 2022.
